categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xinyuren Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of high-end intelligent manufacturing equipment, primarily for lithium-ion battery production including drying equipment, coating machines, roller pressing and slitting equipment, cell assembly lines, hydrogen fuel cell equipment, and optical film roll-to-roll manufacturing equipment. The company also develops key components, new materials, and automation solutions for lithium batteries, photovoltaics, and hydrogen fuel cells.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as vacuum drying, multi-stage roller pressing, dual-sided extrusion coating, digital slitting, and integrated roller pressing and slitting machines. It has proprietary technologies in rapid heating and vacuum insulation, precise coating heads, intelligent control systems, and high-efficiency drying methods. The R&D system integrates equipment, process, and new materials, with significant patent holdings and national awards for technological innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading lithium battery manufacturers including CATL, BYD, and other top-tier companies in the new energy sector. The company serves industries such as lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage, photovoltaics, hydrogen fuel cells, and optical films. Its products support battery manufacturers' production lines and automation needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen and subsidiaries in other Chinese cities such as Huizhou, Dongguan, and Shanghai. It serves domestic markets predominantly, with limited overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinyuren operates mainly in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, providing high-end production equipment and automation solutions to battery manufacturers. It also develops and manufactures key components and new materials, supporting upstream and downstream integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment focused on intelligent manufacturing equipment innovation, including multi-layer simultaneous coating technology, dry electrode equipment for solid-state batteries, and halide solid electrolytes. It emphasizes digital factory construction, core component commercialization, and expansion into new materials like optical films and magnetic storage materials. Collaboration with universities and industry leaders supports its innovation pipeline.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized high-end manufacturing equipment, key components, and new materials. The company also provides integrated automation solutions and after-sales technical services. Sales are mostly project-based with upfront deposits, progress payments, and final acceptance payments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xinyuren is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of lithium battery production equipment with strong R&D capabilities and a differentiated product portfolio. It competes with other Chinese and international equipment suppliers but maintains competitive advantages through patented technologies, comprehensive solutions, and partnerships with top battery makers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 621.8 million, a 4.75% increase year-over-year, but experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 63.26 million due to industry overcapacity and increased impairment provisions. Total assets grew to over RMB 2 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D (11.45% of revenue) and production capacity expansion. The company faces financial pressures but continues strategic growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinyuren emphasizes its integrated 'equipment + process + new materials' innovation model, delivering high-precision, energy-efficient, and intelligent manufacturing solutions tailored to customer needs. Its products improve production efficiency, product quality, and cost-effectiveness for battery manufacturers. Proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and strong customer relationships differentiate it in a competitive market.
